query:
SELECT s."SeasonId", s."Name", s."StartDate", s."EndDate", s."ConcurrencyToken", s."CreationKind", s."CreationPreviousSeasonId"
FROM "Seasons" AS s
INNER JOIN "Clubs" AS c ON s."ClubId" = c."ClubId"
WHERE ($1 OR s."ClubId" = $2) AND s."ClubId" = $3 AND s."CreationOperationId" = $4 AND c."CurrentSeasonId" = s."SeasonId"
LIMIT 2
